about: Her soft-tissue springs per body, as data (P1 R1 jiggle; P1Springs.cs runs them, P1Jiggle drives them on B after P1Laws). Each spring is a mass at a point of its bone (turn: the bone turned toward the mass; shift: the bone moved by it), following that point in the WORLD (root motion, her turns and the clip all move it), on a spring of natural frequency freq_hz (mass-normalised stiffness k = (2 pi f)^2, 1/s^2) and damping ratio zeta, its offset FROM REST held inside reach (m) and per-axis limits (m, in her chest's frame: in = toward her midline, out, up, down, fwd, back; up the short one, so a lean-back keeps two rounds), each eased into past 60% (stiffer and damped: no snap at the stop). squash (r2): the bone's local axis nearest her chest's up scaled by 1 - squash * u (u = the offset up (+) or down (-) from rest over that limit; the other two axes take the volume back): the upper pole flattens on the lift, the lower pole stretches on the drop. Bare sag 16 mm (r2): bare carries its weight (the tip about 10 mm lower than r1) so the push-up (support sag -0.25: 4 mm above the point) is a visible change. At rest the mass sits at sag (m, along world gravity: the weight the rest pose shows), press (m, toward the midline) and tilt (m per unit change of the gravity direction in the parent's frame: she leans, it hangs). Sized by the body: freq * (size_ref_m / len)^size_exp and reach, limits, sag * (len / size_ref_m), len = the bone to its tip at rest (a smaller bust is stiffer and moves less). support (0 bare .. 1 push-up, the worn piece's: ArmorHold.support, P1Jiggle.Support) scales stiffness, damping, reach/limits, sag and press by the 'support' factors (lerp 1 -> factor; squash too); group 'top' answers the top's support, 'bottom' the bottom's. rest_shows (0..1; P1 A shape, round 11): the share of the bare upright offset (sag, press) the bind surface already shows, taken off the offset: her bind is A's sculpt, standing under its own weight, so bare and upright sits AT the bind (A's game stack shows A's breasts unsagged; with it on, B's idle breast bone hung 12.3 deg under rest). rest_down (P1 R1 round 35): the down, in the parent's rest frame, under which the bind shows that weight: her stance's chest (idle, close, Look mean; 6-8 deg back, 6 aside), so standing as she stands sits AT the bind (read upright, the breast bone sat 2.5-3.5 deg off its rest at her stance, the right lower pole 4-6 mm inside A's); the tilt term is read about it too. Support and lean move it from there (the push-up's lift over bare is unchanged). Colliders: the breast samples (p1_spring_samples.json, the skinned surface) kept out of each upper arm's capsule and off the other breast (cleavage plane) beyond what the clip's own pose already has.
